name: waddling-gateway-cloudrun
description: GCP Cloud Run DuckDB gateway: quack_serve + birdshot + forwarder. External agents ATTACH 'quack:<host>:443' to dial in; the forwarder proxies the quack wire protocol to the loopback listener and hosts the birdshot control channel + governed write path. Bundled to plain JS with esbuild at image build (entrypoint.mjs imports the TypeScript gateway-src/), run as `node entrypoint.js`.
